entry.title: SubWerk 0.0.10
entry.summary: **SubForce is now SubWerk: a new name, the same synth.** <!-- werk-rename: keep --> "Force" is the name of Akai's device, so it no longer belongs in this plugin's name. Nothing about the sound changes. - MPC's plugin list shows **SubWerk**, and the plugin lives in `/sdcard/Synths/Devko - VST - SubWerk`. - Your presets, favorites and recents move over by themselves: the installer carries them out of the old `Devko - VST - SubForce` folder and removes it, and the first start renames `/media/AkaiFo
